purpose: Shape and build the surfaces a person navigates.
stance: standing on two short legs, leaning in mid-daub, head tilted at its own work, delighted

body.archetype: plump round soft-bodied creature, oversized head, big cheeks, soft and living rather than built from the thing it carries
body.attachment: a broad wooden artist's palette held against its chest, one thumb through the hole, wet dabs of unmixed colour scattered across it

body.archetype: a body of faceted glass panels, thin lead cames running between them, light passing through it rather than stopping at its surface
body.attachment: a prism set where its eye would be, throwing one white beam out as a fanned band of colour across whatever it faces
